---
title: "Packed data and time"
---



A VRT points at the bytes in the source files. GDAL's multidimensional VRT
does not apply xarray's CF decoding, so whatever xarray decoded on open has to
be described again for GDAL. xvrt does this from the Dataset's `.encoding`.

## Scale, offset and nodata

Gridded products are often stored as `int16` with `scale_factor`,
`add_offset` and `_FillValue`. With xarray's default `mask_and_scale=True`
the in-memory values are floats and the packing has moved out of `.attrs`
into `.encoding`:

::: {#40eac1f9 .cell execution_count=2}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import xarray as xr
from _fixtures import daily_netcdf

paths = daily_netcdf(n=2)
ds = xr.open_mfdataset(paths, combine="nested", concat_dim="time")
print(ds.sst.dtype, {k: ds.sst.encoding[k] for k in ("dtype", "scale_factor", "_FillValue")})
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
float64 {'dtype': dtype('int16'), 'scale_factor': np.float64(0.01), '_FillValue': np.int16(-32768)}
```
:::
:::


xvrt declares the storage dtype and lets GDAL carry the decoding:

::: {#058e91f6 .cell execution_count=3}
``` {.python .cell-code}
from xvrt import write_mdim_vrt

out = write_mdim_vrt(ds, paths, paths[0].parent / "packed.vrt",
                     composition="concat", concat_dim="time")
print("\n".join(l for l in out.read_text().splitlines()
                if any(t in l for t in ("DataType>Int16", "Scale", "Offset", "NoData"))))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
      <DataType>Int16</DataType>
      <NoDataValue>-32768.0</NoDataValue>
      <Offset>0.0</Offset>
      <Scale>0.01</Scale>
```
:::
:::


Declaring the decoded `Float64` with no `<Scale>` instead would hand back raw
counts as if they were physical values. `scale_factor` and `add_offset` are
not repeated as `<Attribute>`s, so readers that decode from attributes do not
apply them twice. With `mask_and_scale=False` the packing stays in `.attrs`
and the result is the same.

## Time

Decoded `datetime64` (or cftime) coordinates are encoded back to numbers with
xarray's own CF encoder, using the original `units` and `calendar` from
`.encoding`:

::: {#97529e4a .cell execution_count=4}
``` {.python .cell-code}
print(ds.time.encoding["units"])
print("\n".join(l for l in out.read_text().splitlines()[:12] if "time" in l or "Unit" in l))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}
```
days since 2026-01-01 12:00:00
    <Dimension name="time" size="2" indexingVariable="time" type="TEMPORAL" />
    <Array name="time">
```
:::
:::


This keeps an origin with a time of day (`12:00:00` here) and non-standard
calendars such as `noleap`. Without stored units the fallback is
`days since 1970-01-01`.
